Task: Rate limiter: fix the window, add a token bucket, clock checks, retry time and per-key buckets
1. Bug: allow lets limit + 1 requests through in a window; it must allow at most limit.

Task: Rate limiter: fix the window, add a token bucket, clock checks, retry time and per-key buckets
1. Bug: allow lets limit + 1 requests through in a window; it must allow at most limit.
2. Add a token bucket. new_bucket(capacity, rate, now) returns a full bucket (tokens = capacity, last = now); rate is tokens added per second, times are whole seconds. take(b, now, n), n >= 1, first refills (tokens = min(capacity, tokens + (now - last) * rate), last = now); then if tokens >= n it removes n tokens and returns (true, bucket), otherwise it returns (false, the refilled bucket).
